intro: SSC CHSL Tier 1 is a screening paper, so its cutoff only decides who gets a Tier 2 admit card. The final merit comes from Tier 2. The figures below use the official UR cutoffs for the LDC and JSA list, which is the largest list.
factors: Difficulty of the shifts you appear in. Normalisation lifts or lowers marks across shifts, so a hard shift does not cost you the way it would without it.
Number of vacancies and number of candidates who appear. Vacancies for 2026 are tentative at about 2,536, which is lower than the 3,131 of the previous cycle.
Attempts and accuracy trends in the paper. The UR Tier 1 cutoff rose from 2021 to 2023 in the data on this site.
caveat: The cutoff data on this site currently covers 2021 to 2023 for Tier 1 and 2021 and 2022 for the final list. Newer cutoffs are not added yet, so treat the band below as a rough guide and add a few marks of safety.
target: Aim for a score a few marks above the UR figure in the shift you appear in, and do not rely on the minimum alone. Check the official result PDF after the result.
